en.title: DHS Updates Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List With Three New Companies
en.summary: The Department of Homeland Security, as Chair of the Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force, published an updated UFLPA Entity List adding three companies linked to forced labor practices in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. This is a trade and import enforcement matter, not a visa or immigration policy change.
points: This notice concerns import restrictions on goods, not visas or immigration benefits.
Three companies, including BGI Genomics, MGI Tech, and Shenzhen BGI Technology, were added to the list.
Goods from listed entities are presumed made with forced labor and barred from U.S. import under 19 U.S.C. 1307.
The updated list supersedes the version published on August 3, 2026.
en.who: Importers of goods into the United States and companies with supply chain ties to listed entities are affected.

es.title: DHS actualiza la lista de entidades de la Ley de Prevención del Trabajo Forzado Uigur con tres nuevas empresas
es.summary: El Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (DHS), como presidente del Grupo de Trabajo de Cumplimiento contra el Trabajo Forzado, publicó una lista actualizada de entidades bajo la UFLPA que agrega tres empresas vinculadas a prácticas de trabajo forzado en la Región Autónoma Uigur de Xinjiang. Se trata de un asunto de comercio y control de importaciones, no de una política de visas o inmigración.
points: Este aviso trata sobre restricciones a la importación de bienes, no sobre visas ni beneficios migratorios.
Se añadieron tres empresas a la lista, incluidas BGI Genomics, MGI Tech y Shenzhen BGI Technology.
Se presume que los productos de las entidades listadas están hechos con trabajo forzado y se prohíbe su importación a Estados Unidos conforme a 19 U.S.C. 1307.
La lista actualizada reemplaza la publicada el 3 de agosto de 2026.

Department of Homeland Security
AGENCY:
Department of Homeland Security.
ACTION:
Notice.
SUMMARY:

The U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS), as the Chair of the Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force (FLETF), announces the publication and availability of the updated Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act (UFLPA) Entity List, a consolidated register of the four lists required to be developed and maintained pursuant to the UFLPA, on the DHS UFLPA website. The updated UFLPA Entity List is also published as an appendix to this notice. This update adds three new entities to the UFLPA Entity List, two of which appear on two separate sub-lists.
DATES:
This notice announces the publication and availability of the UFLPA Entity List updated as of October 29, 2026, included as an appendix to this notice.
ADDRESSES:
Persons seeking additional information on the UFLPA Entity List should email the FLETF at FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov.
FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT:

Samuel Greene, Acting Director, Entity ( printed page 68160) List Office, Trade and Economic Security, Office of Strategy, Policy, and Plans, DHS. Phone: (202) 891-2331, email: FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov.
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

The U.S. Department of Homeland Security, on behalf of the Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force (FLETF), is announcing the publication of the updated UFLPA Entity List, a consolidated register of the four lists required to be developed and maintained pursuant to section 2(d)(2)(B) of the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act (Pub. L. 117-78) (UFLPA), to https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list. The UFLPA Entity List is available as an appendix to this notice. This update adds three entities to the section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii) list of the UFLPA, which identifies entities working with the government of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region (Xinjiang or XUAR) to recruit, transport, transfer, harbor or receive forced labor or Uyghurs, Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, or members of other persecuted groups out of Xinjiang. Two of the three entities are also being added to section 2(d)(2)(B)(v) list of the UFLPA, which identifies facilities and entities that source material from Xinjiang or from persons working with the government of Xinjiang or the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps for purposes of the “poverty alleviation” program or the “pairing-assistance” program or any other government labor scheme that uses forced labor. Future revisions to the UFLPA Entity List, which may include additions, removals, or technical corrections, will be published to https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list and in the appendices of future Federal Register notices. See appendix 1.

Beginning on June 21, 2022, the UFLPA requires the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection to apply a rebuttable presumption that goods mined, produced, or manufactured by entities on the UFLPA Entity List are made with forced labor, and therefore, prohibited from importation into the United States under 19 U.S.C. 1307. See section 3(a) of the UFLPA. As the FLETF revises the UFLPA Entity List, including by making additions, removals, or technical corrections, DHS, on its behalf, will post such revisions to the DHS UFLPA website ( https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list) and also publish the revised UFLPA Entity List as an appendix to a Federal Register notice.
Background
A. The Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force

Section 741 of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act established the FLETF to monitor United States enforcement of the prohibition under section 307 of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (19 U.S.C. 1307). See19 U.S.C. 4681. Pursuant to DHS Delegation Order No. 23034, the DHS Under Secretary for Strategy, Policy, and Plans serves as Chair of the FLETF, an interagency task force that includes the Department of Homeland Security, the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative, and the Departments of Labor, State, Justice, the Treasury, and Commerce as member agencies. 1 See19 U.S.C. 4681; Executive Order 13923 (May 15, 2020). In addition, the FLETF includes five observer agencies: the Departments of Energy and Agriculture, the National Security Council, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Homeland Security Investigations.
B. The Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act: Preventing Goods Made With Forced Labor in the People's Republic of China From Being Imported Into the United States

The UFLPA requires, among other things, that the FLETF, in consultation with the Secretary of Commerce and the Director of National Intelligence, develop a strategy (UFLPA section 2(c)) for supporting enforcement of section 307 of the Tariff Act of 1930, to prevent the importation into the United States of goods, wares, articles, and merchandise mined, produced, or manufactured wholly or in part with forced labor in the People's Republic of China. As required by the UFLPA, the Strategy to Prevent the Importation of Goods Mined, Produced, or Manufactured with Forced Labor in the People's Republic of China, which was published on the DHS website on June 17, 2022 ( see https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-strategy), includes the initial UFLPA Entity List, a consolidated register of the four lists required to be developed and maintained pursuant to the UFLPA. See UFLPA section 2(d)(2)(B).
C. UFLPA Entity List
The UFLPA Entity List addresses distinct requirements set forth in clauses (i), (ii), (iv), and (v) of section 2(d)(2)(B) of the UFLPA that the FLETF identify and publish the following four lists:
(1) a list of entities in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region that mine, produce, or manufacture wholly or in part any goods, wares, articles, and merchandise with forced labor;

(2) a list of entities working with the government of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region to recruit, transport, transfer, harbor or receive forced labor or Uyghurs, Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, or members of other persecuted groups out of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region;
(3) a list of entities that exported products made by entities in lists 1 and 2 from the People's Republic of China into the United States; and.

(4) a list of facilities and entities, including the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, that source material from the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region or from persons working with the government of Xinjiang or the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps for purposes of the “poverty alleviation” program or the “pairing-assistance” program or any other government-labor scheme that uses forced labor.

The UFLPA Entity List is a consolidated register of the above four lists. In accordance with section 3(e) of the UFLPA, effective June 21, 2022, entities on the UFLPA Entity List (listed entities) are subject to the UFLPA's rebuttable presumption that products they produce, wholly or in part, are made with forced labor and prohibited from entry into the United States under 19 U.S.C. 1307. The UFLPA Entity List is provided as appendix 1 to this notice. The UFLPA Entity List should not be interpreted as an exhaustive list of entities engaged in the practices described in clauses (i), (ii), (iv), or (v) of section 2(d)(2)(B) of the UFLPA.

Revisions to the UFLPA Entity List, including all additions, removals, and technical corrections, will be published on the DHS UFLPA website ( https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list) and as an appendix to a notice that will be published in the Federal Register . See appendix 1. The FLETF will consider future additions to, or removals from, the UFLPA Entity List based on criteria described in clauses (i), (ii), (iv), or (v) of Section 2(d)(2)(B) of the UFLPA. Any FLETF member agency may submit a recommendation(s) to add, remove or make technical corrections to an entry ( printed page 68161) on the UFLPA Entity List. FLETF member agencies will review and vote on revisions to the UFLPA Entity List accordingly.
Additions to the Entity List

The FLETF will consider future additions to the UFLPA Entity List based on the criteria described in clauses (i), (ii), (iv), or (v) of section 2(d)(2)(B) of the UFLPA. Any FLETF member agency may submit a recommendation to the FLETF Chair to add an entity to the UFLPA Entity List. Following review of the recommendation by the FLETF member agencies, the decision to add an entity to the UFLPA Entity List will be made by majority vote of the FLETF member agencies.
Requests for Removal From the Entity List

Any listed entity may submit a request for removal (removal request) from the UFLPA Entity List along with supporting information to the FLETF Chair at FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov. In the removal request, the entity (or its designated representative) should provide information that demonstrates that the entity no longer meets or does not meet the criteria described in the applicable clause ((i), (ii), (iv), or (v)) of section 2(d)(2)(B) of the UFLPA. The FLETF Chair will refer all such removal requests and supporting information to FLETF member agencies. Upon receipt of the removal request, the FLETF Chair or the Chair's designated representative may contact the entity on behalf of the FLETF with questions on the removal request and may request additional information. Following review of the removal request by the FLETF member agencies, the decision to remove an entity from the UFLPA Entity List will be made by majority vote of the FLETF member agencies.

Listed entities may request a meeting with the FLETF after submitting a removal request in writing to the FLETF Chair at FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov. Following its review of a removal request, the FLETF may accept the meeting request at the conclusion of the review period and, if accepted, will hold the meeting prior to voting on the entity's removal request. The FLETF Chair will advise the entity in writing of the FLETF's decision on its removal request. While the FLETF's decision on a removal request is not appealable, the FLETF will consider new removal requests if accompanied by new information.
Robert T. Law,
Under Secretary, Office of Strategy, Policy, & Plans, U.S. Department of Homeland Security.
Appendix 1

This notice supersedes the UFLPA Entity List published in the Federal Register on August 3, 2026 (91 FR 48913). The UFLPA Entity List as of October 29, 2026 is available in this appendix and is published on https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list. This update adds three entities to section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii) list of the UFLPA, which identifies entities working with the government of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region to recruit, transport, transfer, harbor or receive forced labor or Uyghurs, Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, or members of other persecuted groups out of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region:
BGI Genomics Co., Ltd. (also known as BGI Genomics)
MGI Tech Co., Ltd. (also known as MGI)
Shenzhen BGI Technology Co., Ltd. (also known as BGI Group; and BGI Holdings)

BGI Genomics Co., Ltd. (also known as BGI Genomics) is located in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China. Shenzhen BGI Technology Co., Ltd., also included on the UFLPA Entity List, is the company's controlling shareholder. BGI Genomics' main business includes providing research services, comprehensive solutions for precision medicine testing, and health management services through gene testing, mass spectrometry, bioinformatics analysis, and multimodal intelligent analysis models. The United States Government has reasonable cause to believe, based on specific and articulable information, that BGI Genomics conducts genetic testing in the XUAR alongside the government of the XUAR and as a part of its government initiatives. Such genetic testing is utilized to facilitate the recruitment, transport, transfer, harboring or receiving of forced labor or Uyghurs Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, or members of other persecuted groups out of Xinjiang. The FLETF therefore determined the activities of BGI Genomics satisfy the criterion for addition to the UFLPA Entity List described in section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii).

MGI Tech Co., Ltd. (also known as MGI) is located in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China. MGI is under the control of the same ultimate controlling shareholder as Shenzhen BGI Technology Co., Ltd., also included on the UFLPA Entity List. MGI's business activities focus on the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of instruments, reagents, and related products in the field of life science and biotechnology. The United States Government has reasonable cause to believe, based on specific and articulable information, that MGI has provisioned genetic testing capacity to the XUAR government to conduct genetic testing in the XUAR including as a part of its government initiatives. Such genetic testing is utilized to facilitate the recruitment, transport, transfer, harboring or receiving of forced labor or Uyghurs Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, or members of other persecuted groups out of Xinjiang. The FLETF therefore determined the activities of MGI satisfy the criterion for addition to the UFLPA Entity List described in section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii).

Shenzhen BGI Technology Co., Ltd. (also known as BGI Group; and BGI Holdings) is a company located in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China. BGI Group is a genomics and biotechnology company that develops and applies genetic sequencing technologies for research, healthcare, and commercial use. It provides DNA, RNA, and metabolomics sequencing technology and can provide services, as well as equipment, technical support, and precision medicine and health solutions. The company also built and manages the China National GeneBank, a national-level biological data and sample repository. The United States Government has reasonable cause to believe, based on specific and articulable information, that BGI Group conduct genetic testing in the XUAR alongside the XUAR government and as a part of its government initiatives. Such genetic testing is utilized to facilitate the recruitment, transport, transfer, harboring or receiving of forced labor or Uyghurs Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, or members of other persecuted groups out of Xinjiang. The FLETF therefore determined the activities of BGI Group satisfy the criterion for addition to the UFLPA Entity List described in section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii).

요약:

미국 국토안보부(DHS)는 강제노동집행태스크포스(FLETF) 의장으로서, 위구르족 강제노동방지법(UFLPA)에 따라 작성 및 유지가 요구되는 네 개 목록을 통합한 명부인 최신 UFLPA 단체 목록(UFLPA Entity List)이 DHS UFLPA 웹사이트에 게시되어 열람 가능함을 공고합니다. 최신 UFLPA 단체 목록은 본 통지의 부록으로도 게재됩니다. 이번 갱신은 UFLPA 단체 목록에 세 개의 신규 단체를 추가하며, 그 중 두 개 단체는 두 개의 개별 하위 목록에 각각 등재됩니다.
일자:
본 통지는 2026년 10월 29일 자로 갱신된 UFLPA 단체 목록이 게시 및 열람 가능하게 되었음을 공고하며, 이는 본 통지의 부록에 포함되어 있습니다.
주소:
UFLPA 단체 목록에 관한 추가 정보를 구하는 자는 FLETF에 FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov로 이메일을 보내야 합니다.
추가 문의처:
Samuel Greene, 단체 목록실(Entity List Office) 부국장 대행, 무역 및 경제안보실, 전략·정책·계획실, DHS. ( 인쇄본 68160페이지) 전화: (202) 891-2331, 이메일: FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov.
보충 정보:

미국 국토안보부는 강제노동집행태스크포스(FLETF)를 대신하여, 위구르족 강제노동방지법(공법 제117-78호)(UFLPA) 제2조(d)(2)(B)항에 따라 작성 및 유지가 요구되는 네 개 목록을 통합한 명부인 최신 UFLPA 단체 목록이 https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list 에 게시되었음을 공고합니다. UFLPA 단체 목록은 본 통지의 부록으로 열람 가능합니다. 이번 갱신은 UFLPA 제2조(d)(2)(B)(ii)항에 따른 목록에 세 개 단체를 추가하는 것으로, 이 목록은 신장위구르자치구(신장 또는 XUAR) 정부와 협력하여 위구르족, 카자흐족, 키르기스족 또는 그 밖의 박해받는 집단의 구성원을 강제노동을 위해 신장 밖으로 모집, 수송, 이전, 은닉 또는 인수하는 단체를 식별합니다. 세 개 단체 중 두 개는 UFLPA 제2조(d)(2)(B)(v)항에 따른 목록에도 추가되는데, 이 목록은 "빈곤퇴치" 프로그램, "짝짓기 지원(pairing-assistance)" 프로그램 또는 강제노동을 이용하는 그 밖의 정부 노동제도를 목적으로 신장 또는 신장 정부나 신장생산건설병단과 협력하는 자로부터 자재를 조달하는 시설 및 단체를 식별합니다. UFLPA 단체 목록에 대한 향후 개정, 즉 추가, 삭제 또는 기술적 정정을 포함할 수 있는 개정 사항은 https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list 및 향후 연방관보 통지의 부록에 게재될 것입니다. 부록 1을 참조하십시오.

2022년 6월 21일부터, UFLPA는 미국 세관국경보호청(CBP) 청장으로 하여금 UFLPA 단체 목록에 등재된 단체가 채굴, 생산 또는 제조한 물품은 강제노동에 의해 생산된 것으로 추정한다는 반박 가능한 추정을 적용하도록 요구하며, 따라서 그러한 물품은 19 U.S.C. 1307에 따라 미국으로의 수입이 금지됩니다. UFLPA 제3조(a)항을 참조하십시오. FLETF가 UFLPA 단체 목록을 개정함에 따라, 즉 추가, 삭제 또는 기술적 정정을 함에 따라, DHS는 FLETF를 대신하여 그러한 개정 사항을 DHS UFLPA 웹사이트(https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list)에 게시하고, 개정된 UFLPA 단체 목록을 연방관보 통지의 부록으로도 게재할 것입니다.
배경
가. 강제노동집행태스크포스

미국-멕시코-캐나다 협정 이행법(United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act) 제741조는 1930년 관세법(Tariff Act of 1930) 제307조(개정, 19 U.S.C. 1307)에 따른 금지사항에 대한 미국의 집행을 감독하기 위하여 강제노동집행태스크포스(FLETF)를 설립하였습니다. 19 U.S.C. 4681 참조. 국토안보부(Department of Homeland Security, DHS) 위임명령 제23034호에 따라, DHS 전략정책기획차관(Under Secretary for Strategy, Policy, and Plans)이 FLETF의 의장을 맡고 있으며, FLETF는 국토안보부, 미국무역대표부(Office of the U.S. Trade Representative), 노동부, 국무부, 법무부, 재무부 및 상무부를 구성 기관으로 포함하는 부처간 태스크포스입니다. 1 19 U.S.C. 4681 참조, 행정명령 13923호(2020년 5월 15일) 참조. 그 밖에도, FLETF에는 에너지부, 농무부, 국가안보회의(National Security Council), 미국세관국경보호청(U.S. Customs and Border Protection), 미국이민세관집행청 국토안보수사국(U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Homeland Security Investigations)의 5개 옵서버 기관이 포함됩니다.
B. 위구르족 강제노동 방지법: 중화인민공화국에서 강제노동으로 제조된 상품의 미국 내 수입 방지

UFLPA는 특히 FLETF가 상무부 장관 및 국가정보국장(Director of National Intelligence)과 협의하여, 중화인민공화국에서 전부 또는 일부가 강제노동으로 채굴, 생산 또는 제조된 상품, 제품, 물품 및 상품류의 미국 내 수입을 방지하기 위하여 1930년 관세법 제307조의 집행을 지원하기 위한 전략(UFLPA 제2조(c))을 수립할 것을 요구하고 있습니다. UFLPA가 요구하는 바에 따라, 2022년 6월 17일 DHS 웹사이트에 게시된 중화인민공화국에서 강제노동으로 채굴, 생산 또는 제조된 상품의 수입을 방지하기 위한 전략(Strategy to Prevent the Importation of Goods Mined, Produced, or Manufactured with Forced Labor in the People's Republic of China)(https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-strategy 참조)에는 UFLPA에 따라 개발 및 유지되어야 하는 4개 목록을 통합한 명부인 초기 UFLPA 단체목록(UFLPA Entity List)이 포함되어 있습니다. UFLPA 제2조(d)(2)(B) 참조.
C. UFLPA 단체목록
UFLPA 단체목록은 FLETF가 다음의 4개 목록을 식별하고 공표하도록 규정한 UFLPA 제2조(d)(2)(B)의 (i)호, (ii)호, (iv)호 및 (v)호에 명시된 별개의 요건을 다루고 있습니다.
(1) 신장위구르자치구 내에서 전부 또는 일부가 강제노동으로 상품, 제품, 물품 및 상품류를 채굴, 생산 또는 제조하는 단체의 목록
(2) 신장위구르자치구 정부와 협력하여 강제노동 또는 위구르족, 카자흐족, 키르기스족 또는 기타 박해받는 집단의 구성원을 신장위구르자치구 밖으로 모집, 운송, 이송, 은닉 또는 수용하는 단체의 목록

Dos de las tres entidades también se están agregando a la lista de la sección 2(d)(2)(B)(v) de la UFLPA, que identifica instalaciones y entidades que obtienen material de Xinjiang o de personas que trabajan con el gobierno de Xinjiang o con el Cuerpo de Producción y Construcción de Xinjiang para los fines del programa de "alivio de la pobreza" o del programa de "asistencia emparejada" o de cualquier otro esquema laboral gubernamental que utilice trabajo forzado. A partir del 21 de junio de 2022, la UFLPA exige que el Comisionado de la Oficina de Aduanas y Protección Fronteriza de los Estados Unidos (CBP, por sus siglas en inglés) aplique una presunción refutable de que los bienes extraídos, producidos o fabricados por entidades incluidas en la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA son elaborados con trabajo forzado y, por lo tanto, su importación a los Estados Unidos está prohibida conforme al 19 U.S.C. 1307. Véase la sección 3(a) de la UFLPA. A medida que el FLETF revise la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA, incluso mediante adiciones, eliminaciones o correcciones técnicas, el DHS, en su representación, publicará dichas revisiones en el sitio web del DHS sobre la UFLPA (https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list) y también publicará la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA revisada como anexo de un aviso del Registro Federal.
Antecedentes
A. El Grupo de Trabajo para el Cumplimiento de la Ley sobre Trabajo Forzado

La Sección 741 de la Ley de Implementación del Tratado entre Estados Unidos, México y Canadá estableció el FLETF para supervisar el cumplimiento, por parte de Estados Unidos, de la prohibición establecida en la sección 307 de la Ley Arancelaria de 1930, según enmendada (19 U.S.C. 1307). Véase 19 U.S.C. 4681. De conformidad con la Orden de Delegación N.º 23034 del DHS, el Subsecretario de Estrategia, Política y Planes del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (DHS) ejerce como Presidente del FLETF, un grupo de trabajo interinstitucional que incluye al Departamento de Seguridad Nacional, la Oficina del Representante Comercial de los Estados Unidos, y a los Departamentos de Trabajo, Estado, Justicia, del Tesoro y Comercio como agencias miembro. 1 Véase 19 U.S.C. 4681; Orden Ejecutiva 13923 (15 de mayo de 2020). Además, el FLETF incluye cinco agencias observadoras: los Departamentos de Energía y Agricultura, el Consejo de Seguridad Nacional, la Oficina de Aduanas y Protección Fronteriza de los Estados Unidos (CBP) y la División de Investigaciones de Seguridad Nacional del Servicio de Control de Inmigración y Aduanas de los Estados Unidos (ICE).
B. La Ley de Prevención del Trabajo Forzado de los Uigures: Prevención de la Importación a Estados Unidos de Bienes Fabricados con Trabajo Forzado en la República Popular China

La UFLPA exige, entre otras cosas, que el FLETF, en consulta con el Secretario de Comercio y el Director de Inteligencia Nacional, desarrolle una estrategia (sección 2(c) de la UFLPA) para respaldar el cumplimiento de la sección 307 de la Ley Arancelaria de 1930, a fin de impedir la importación a Estados Unidos de bienes, artículos, mercancías y productos extraídos, producidos o fabricados, total o parcialmente, con trabajo forzado en la República Popular China. Conforme a lo exigido por la UFLPA, la Estrategia para Prevenir la Importación de Bienes Extraídos, Producidos o Fabricados con Trabajo Forzado en la República Popular China, publicada en el sitio web del DHS el 17 de junio de 2022 (véase https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-strategy), incluye la Lista Inicial de Entidades de la UFLPA, un registro consolidado de las cuatro listas que deben elaborarse y mantenerse conforme a la UFLPA. Véase la sección 2(d)(2)(B) de la UFLPA.
C. Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA

La Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA aborda los requisitos específicos establecidos en las cláusulas (i), (ii), (iv) y (v) de la sección 2(d)(2)(B) de la UFLPA, según los cuales el FLETF debe identificar y publicar las siguientes cuatro listas:
(1) una lista de entidades en la Región Autónoma Uigur de Xinjiang que extraen, producen o fabrican, total o parcialmente, bienes, artículos y mercancías con trabajo forzado;

(2) una lista de entidades que colaboran con el gobierno de la Región Autónoma Uigur de Xinjiang para reclutar, transportar, transferir, albergar o recibir trabajo forzado o a uigures, kazajos, kirguises o miembros de otros grupos perseguidos fuera de la Región Autónoma Uigur de Xinjiang;
(3) una lista de entidades que exportaron a Estados Unidos, desde la República Popular China, productos fabricados por entidades incluidas en las listas 1 y 2; y.

(4) una lista de instalaciones y entidades, incluido el Cuerpo de Producción y Construcción de Xinjiang, que obtienen material de la Región Autónoma Uigur de Xinjiang o de personas que colaboran con el gobierno de Xinjiang o con el Cuerpo de Producción y Construcción de Xinjiang para fines del programa de “alivio de la pobreza” o del programa de “asistencia emparejada”, o de cualquier otro esquema gubernamental de mano de obra que utilice trabajo forzado.

La Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA es un registro consolidado de las cuatro listas mencionadas. De conformidad con la sección 3(e) de la UFLPA, a partir del 21 de junio de 2022, las entidades incluidas en la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA (entidades listadas) están sujetas a la presunción refutable de la UFLPA de que los productos que fabrican, total o parcialmente, están hechos con trabajo forzado y se encuentran prohibidos de ingresar a Estados Unidos conforme a 19 U.S.C. 1307. La Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA se proporciona como apéndice 1 de este aviso. La Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA no debe interpretarse como una lista exhaustiva de las entidades que participan en las prácticas descritas en las cláusulas (i), (ii), (iv) o (v) de la sección 2(d)(2)(B) de la UFLPA.

Las revisiones a la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA, incluyendo todas las adiciones, eliminaciones y correcciones técnicas, se publicarán en el sitio web de la UFLPA del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (DHS) (https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list) y como un apéndice a un aviso que se publicará en el Registro Federal. Véase el apéndice 1. El FLETF considerará futuras adiciones a, o eliminaciones de, la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA con base en los criterios descritos en las cláusulas (i), (ii), (iv), o (v) de la Sección 2(d)(2)(B) de la UFLPA. Cualquier agencia miembro del FLETF puede presentar una recomendación o recomendaciones para agregar, eliminar o realizar correcciones técnicas a una entrada (página impresa 68161) en la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA. Las agencias miembros del FLETF revisarán y votarán sobre las revisiones a la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA en consecuencia.
Adiciones a la Lista de Entidades

El FLETF considerará futuras adiciones a la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA con base en los criterios descritos en las cláusulas (i), (ii), (iv), o (v) de la sección 2(d)(2)(B) de la UFLPA. Cualquier agencia miembro del FLETF puede presentar una recomendación al Presidente del FLETF para agregar una entidad a la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA. Tras la revisión de la recomendación por parte de las agencias miembros del FLETF, la decisión de agregar una entidad a la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA se tomará por voto mayoritario de las agencias miembros del FLETF.
Solicitudes de Eliminación de la Lista de Entidades

Cualquier entidad incluida en la lista puede presentar una solicitud de eliminación (solicitud de eliminación) de la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA junto con la información de respaldo al Presidente del FLETF en FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov. En la solicitud de eliminación, la entidad (o su representante designado) debe proporcionar información que demuestre que la entidad ya no cumple o no cumple con los criterios descritos en la cláusula aplicable ((i), (ii), (iv), o (v)) de la sección 2(d)(2)(B) de la UFLPA. El Presidente del FLETF remitirá todas esas solicitudes de eliminación e información de respaldo a las agencias miembros del FLETF. Al recibir la solicitud de eliminación, el Presidente del FLETF o su representante designado puede ponerse en contacto con la entidad en nombre del FLETF con preguntas sobre la solicitud de eliminación y puede solicitar información adicional. Tras la revisión de la solicitud de eliminación por parte de las agencias miembros del FLETF, la decisión de eliminar una entidad de la Lista de Entidades de la UFLPA se tomará por voto mayoritario de las agencias miembros del FLETF.

Las entidades incluidas en la lista pueden solicitar una reunión con el FLETF después de presentar una solicitud de eliminación por escrito al Presidente del FLETF en FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov. Tras su revisión de una solicitud de eliminación, el FLETF puede aceptar la solicitud de reunión al concluir el período de revisión y, de ser aceptada, celebrará la reunión antes de votar sobre la solicitud de eliminación de la entidad. El Presidente del FLETF notificará por escrito a la entidad la decisión del FLETF sobre su solicitud de eliminación. Si bien la decisión del FLETF sobre una solicitud de eliminación no es apelable, el FLETF considerará nuevas solicitudes de eliminación si van acompañadas de nueva información.

自2022年6月21日起,UFLPA要求美国海关与边境保护局(CBP)局长适用可反驳的推定,即由UFLPA实体清单上的实体开采、生产或制造的商品系以强迫劳动制成,因此根据《美国法典》第19编第1307条,禁止将其进口至美国。见UFLPA第3(a)条。随着FLETF对UFLPA实体清单进行修订,包括新增、移除或技术性更正,DHS将代表FLETF在DHS的UFLPA网站(https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list)上发布此类修订内容,并将经修订的UFLPA实体清单作为《联邦公报》通知的附录予以发布。
背景
A. 强迫劳动执法工作组

《美墨加协定实施法》第741条设立了强迫劳动执法工作组(FLETF),以监督美国对经修订的1930年《关税法》第307条(19 U.S.C. 1307)所规定禁令的执行情况。参见19 U.S.C. 4681。根据《美国国土安全部第23034号授权令》,美国国土安全部(DHS)负责战略、政策和规划的副部长担任强迫劳动执法工作组主席,该跨部门工作组成员机构包括美国国土安全部、美国贸易代表办公室以及劳工部、国务院、司法部、财政部和商务部。1 参见19 U.S.C. 4681;第13923号行政命令(2020年5月15日)。此外,强迫劳动执法工作组还包括五个观察员机构:能源部、农业部、国家安全委员会、美国海关与边境保护局(CBP)以及美国移民与海关执法局(ICE)国土安全调查处。
B. 《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》:防止中华人民共和国境内使用强迫劳动制造的商品进口至美国

《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》(UFLPA)除其他事项外,要求强迫劳动执法工作组在与商务部长和国家情报总监协商后,制定一项战略(UFLPA第2(c)条),以支持执行1930年《关税法》第307条,防止全部或部分在中华人民共和国使用强迫劳动开采、生产或制造的商品、货物、物品及商品货物进口至美国。根据UFLPA的要求,《防止使用强迫劳动在中华人民共和国开采、生产或制造的商品进口的战略》已于2022年6月17日在美国国土安全部网站上公布(参见https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-strategy),该战略包括最初的UFLPA实体清单,这是依据UFLPA要求制定并维护的四份清单的合并登记册。参见UFLPA第2(d)(2)(B)条。
C. UFLPA实体清单
UFLPA实体清单涉及UFLPA第2(d)(2)(B)条第(i)、(ii)、(iv)和(v)款所规定的不同要求,该条要求强迫劳动执法工作组识别并公布以下四份清单:
(1) 新疆维吾尔自治区内全部或部分使用强迫劳动开采、生产或制造任何商品、货物、物品及商品货物的实体清单;
(2) 与新疆维吾尔自治区政府合作,将强迫劳动人员或维吾尔族、哈萨克族、柯尔克孜族或其他受迫害群体成员招募、运输、转移、窝藏或接收出新疆维吾尔自治区的实体清单;
(3) 将清单1和清单2所列实体制造的产品从中华人民共和国出口至美国的实体清单;以及
(4) 为“扶贫”计划或“对口援助”计划或任何其他使用强迫劳动的政府劳动安排目的,从新疆维吾尔自治区或与新疆政府或新疆生产建设兵团合作的人员处采购原材料的设施和实体清单,包括新疆生产建设兵团。

UFLPA实体清单是上述四份清单的合并登记册。根据UFLPA第3(e)条,自2022年6月21日起生效,UFLPA实体清单上的实体(被列名实体)须适用UFLPA的可反驳推定,即其全部或部分生产的产品系使用强迫劳动制造,并根据19 U.S.C. 1307禁止其进入美国。UFLPA实体清单作为本通知的附录1提供。UFLPA实体清单不应被解释为从事UFLPA第2(d)(2)(B)条第(i)、(ii)、(iv)或(v)款所述行为的实体的详尽清单。

对《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》(UFLPA)实体清单的修订,包括所有新增、移除及技术性更正,将公布于美国国土安全部(DHS)的UFLPA网站(https://www.dhs.gov/​uflpa-entity-list),并作为将在《联邦公报》上发布的通知的附录予以公布。参见附录一。强迫劳动预防工作组(FLETF)将依据UFLPA第2(d)(2)(B)条第(i)、(ii)、(iv)或(v)项所述标准,考虑今后对UFLPA实体清单的新增或移除。任何FLETF成员机构均可就清单条目的新增、移除或技术更正提出建议(第68161页),供FLETF审议。FLETF成员机构将据此对UFLPA实体清单的修订进行审议并表决。
实体清单的新增
FLETF将依据UFLPA第2(d)(2)(B)条第(i)、(ii)、(iv)或(v)项所述标准,考虑今后对UFLPA实体清单的新增。任何FLETF成员机构均可向FLETF主席提交建议,将某实体列入UFLPA实体清单。经FLETF成员机构审议该建议后,是否将某实体列入UFLPA实体清单的决定,将由FLETF成员机构以多数表决方式作出。
从实体清单中移除的请求

任何被列名实体均可向FLETF主席提交移除请求(移除请求)及相关佐证材料,联系方式为FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov。在移除请求中,该实体(或其指定代表)应提供能够证明该实体已不再符合或本不符合UFLPA第2(d)(2)(B)条相应项((i)、(ii)、(iv)或(v))所述标准的信息。FLETF主席将把所有此类移除请求及佐证材料转交FLETF成员机构。收到移除请求后,FLETF主席或主席指定代表可代表FLETF就移除请求中的问题与该实体联系,并可要求提供补充信息。经FLETF成员机构审议移除请求后,是否将某实体从UFLPA实体清单中移除的决定,将由FLETF成员机构以多数表决方式作出。

被列名实体在以书面形式向FLETF主席(联系方式:FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov)提交移除请求后,可申请与FLETF举行会议。FLETF在完成对移除请求的审议后,可在审议期结束时接受该会议申请,若接受,将在就该实体移除请求进行表决之前举行会议。FLETF主席将以书面形式告知该实体FLETF就其移除请求作出的决定。尽管FLETF就移除请求作出的决定不可申诉,但如附有新的信息,FLETF将考虑受理新的移除请求。

機関:

措置:
通知。
概要:

国土安全保障省(DHS)は、強制労働執行タスクフォース(FLETF)の議長として、ウイグル強制労働防止法(UFLPA)に基づき作成及び維持することが義務付けられている4つのリストを統合した名簿である、更新されたUFLPAエンティティリストの公表及び公開をDHSのUFLPAウェブサイトにおいて発表する。更新されたUFLPAエンティティリストは、本通知の付録としても公表される。本更新により、UFLPAエンティティリストに3の新たな事業体が追加され、そのうち2の事業体は2つの異なるサブリストに掲載されている。
日付:
本通知は、本通知の付録として掲載される、2026年10月29日時点で更新されたUFLPAエンティティリストの公表及び公開を発表するものである。
連絡先:
UFLPAエンティティリストに関する追加情報を求める者は、FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.govまでFLETFに電子メールを送付されたい。
問い合わせ先:
Samuel Greene、エンティティリスト室(印刷版68160ページ)、貿易・経済安全保障、戦略・政策・計画局、DHS、代理室長。電話:(202) 891-2331、電子メール:FLETF.UFLPA.EntityList@hq.dhs.gov。
補足情報:

国土安全保障省は、強制労働執行タスクフォース(FLETF)を代表して、ウイグル強制労働防止法(公法117-78)(UFLPA)第2条(d)(2)(B)に基づき作成及び維持することが義務付けられている4つのリストを統合した名簿である、更新されたUFLPAエンティティリストを、https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-listに公表することを発表する。UFLPAエンティティリストは本通知の付録として入手可能である。本更新により、新疆ウイグル自治区(新疆又はXUAR)政府と連携して、新疆からウイグル人、カザフ人、キルギス人又はその他の迫害されている集団の構成員を募集、輸送、移送、蔵匿又は収受して強制労働に従事させる事業体を識別する、UFLPA第2条(d)(2)(B)(ii)のリストに3の事業体が追加される。これら3の事業体のうち2は、「貧困緩和」計画若しくは「援助ペアリング」計画又は強制労働を利用するその他の政府の労働制度の目的のために、新疆又は新疆政府若しくは新疆生産建設兵団と連携する者から資材を調達する施設及び事業体を識別する、UFLPA第2条(d)(2)(B)(v)のリストにも追加される。UFLPAエンティティリストの今後の改訂は、追加、削除又は技術的修正を含む場合があるが、https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list及び今後の連邦官報通知の付録において公表される。付録1を参照のこと。

2022年6月21日以降、UFLPAは、米国税関・国境警備局(CBP)長官に対し、UFLPAエンティティリストに掲載された事業体によって採掘、生産又は製造された物品は強制労働によって製造されたものであるという反証可能な推定を適用することを義務付けており、したがって、当該物品は19 U.S.C. 1307に基づき米国への輸入が禁止される。UFLPA第3条(a)を参照のこと。FLETFがUFLPAエンティティリストを改訂する際、追加、削除又は技術的修正を行う場合を含め、DHSはFLETFを代表して、当該改訂をDHSのUFLPAウェブサイト(https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list)に掲載するとともに、改訂されたUFLPAエンティティリストを連邦官報通知の付録として公表する。
